Purpose of the alpha

Alpha product and methodology test. Run 1 produces a North Macedonia diagnostic (run 1a) and a comparator pilot (run 1b), and tests the end-to-end workflow, source collection and processing, extraction and classification, taxonomy and matching, the human review gates, assessment and judgement, outputs, and the usefulness of the review page. Lessons are recorded in the alpha learning log to inform scaling to further chapters, clusters and countries

Scope Validated

Target country
North Macedonia (MKD)
Thematic scope
(a) All of Chapter 2, Freedom of movement for workers (Cluster 2, Internal market); (b) the technology and AI theme: recommendations materially relating to the areas listed in taxonomy/themes.csv (theme group TECH), wherever they occur in the accession material. Incidental references to technology are out of scope. The full analytical chain is followed for every issue originating from an in-scope Chapter 2 item or technology and AI recommendation. Material outside (a) and (b) is out of scope unless it is needed to follow the chain of an issue already in scope.
Time window
2020-01-01 to the evidence freeze date; earlier material only by logged exception where needed to understand the origin or evolution of an in-scope issue
Language
English primary; Macedonian or Albanian only for core relevant sources with no suitable English version, each recorded in the register; machine translation flagged and capped at Medium confidence
Comparator scope
Run 1b only: two or three reform issues selected at G6, with two or three comparator countries each, approved at G1b

Cross-cutting theme areas

CodeAreaDefinition
TECH-AIArtificial intelligenceThe development, use, regulation or oversight of artificial intelligence systems, including alignment with EU rules on artificial intelligence.
TECH-DGOVDigital government and digital public servicesElectronic administration and public services delivered or managed digitally, including e-government portals and online procedures.
TECH-INFRADigital infrastructure and connectivityBroadband, mobile and other electronic communications networks, and access to them.
TECH-DATAData and data governanceThe collection, protection, quality, sharing, reuse and governance of data, including personal data protection and open data.
TECH-CYBERCybersecurityThe security of networks and information systems, including incident response capacity and cybersecurity rules.
TECH-EIDDigital identityElectronic identification, electronic signatures and other trust services.
TECH-INTEROPInteroperability and electronic systemsThe ability of information systems to exchange data, and the electronic systems used to run or connect administrative processes, including connection to EU systems.
TECH-DIGIDigitalisation of government or economic activityMoving government processes or economic activity onto digital means, including digital transformation programmes and the digitalisation of businesses.

Sources Not started

Will show the source requirements and gaps, the source register by family, year, chapter and theme, exclusions and inaccessible documents, and source quality ratings. Populated from stage 1; validated at G1 and G2.

Extraction Not started

Will show the extraction sample, the comparison with hand-coded passages, accuracy and error patterns, and the rules version approved. Populated from stage 5; validated at G3.

Taxonomy Not started

Will show the reform issues for the in-scope chapters and themes, the problem mechanisms, and items that fit no issue. Populated from stage 7; validated at G4.

Classification Not started

Will show classification coverage, resolved queues, interventions and actors, conflicting evidence and items found to be out of scope. Populated from stage 9; validated at G5.

Assessment Not started

Will show one dossier per reform issue: the chain from EU requirement to unresolved gap, direction of travel, priority and tractability, with source quality, evidence confidence and relevance shown side by side. Populated from stage 10; validated at G6.

Comparator pilot (run 1b) Not started

Will show the issues chosen for the pilot, comparator countries and cases, lessons and transferability. Populated after G6; validated at G1b to G6b.

Outputs Not started

Will show the scope overview, issue briefs, the source coverage and limits report, comparator briefs and draft policy options. Draft policy options stay labelled as internal drafts after sign-off. Populated from stage 12; validated at G7.

Alpha lessons

Curated lessons from runs/RUN-2026-01/alpha_learning_log.csv. Each is confirmed by the analyst at a gate.

IDAreaLessonScalingStatus
ALN-0001workflowChanging the pilot country from Serbia to North Macedonia before G0 required edits to about thirty files because country, chapter, dates, languages and examples were written into the codebooks, procedures and rules.countries; chaptersValidated implemented
ALN-0002taxonomy matchingA scope combining one chapter with a cross-cutting theme (technology and AI) could not be expressed with chapter and cluster fields alone, so theme tags planned for a later stage had to be brought forward.chapters; clustersValidated accepted
ALN-0003toolingThe helper tools depend on system software (text recognition with Macedonian and Albanian language data, PDF rendering) that was not installed in the working environment and was not recorded anywhere before stage 0.countries; languagesValidated implemented
